name: phishlens
description: AI Phishing Detection Platform — web app, API and shared analysis engine

scripts.build: npm run build -w @phishlens/core && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @phishlens/core && npm test -w @phishlens/core -w api -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @phishlens/core && npm run typecheck -w api && npx -w web tsc --noEmit
